hint.label: Availability
hint.body: Enabled: projects can activate this pipeline and the wiring is locked. Disable to edit, delete, or promote — only possible while no project has it activated.

promote.title: Promote to organization
promote.desc: Share this pipeline with your whole organization. It moves out of your personal scope; every member can see and activate it, and you remain its owner.
promote.confirmMessage: Promote "{{name}}" to your organization? The pipeline moves out of your personal scope — every member can then see and activate it, and you stay its owner.

orgAccess.title: Organization access
orgAccess.desc: Every member can see and activate this pipeline. Editing is limited to the owner, org admins, and the editors you delegate here.
orgAccess.noMembers: No other members in this organization yet.

editor.editBlockedEnabled: Disable the pipeline (toggle) to edit its wiring.

trigger.overlap: If the previous run is still live

step.intentsUnavailable: Intent catalog failed to parse — fix the definition in Agent Settings.
step.directivePlaceholder: What should this run do? Leave empty to run the default directive.
step.templateVarsHint: Substituted with the actual values when the schedule fires — insert at the cursor.
step.contextHint: Pins are resolved when this step fires — you can pre-pin a path an earlier step will create; needs-ordering means it is existence-checked only after that step finished.
step.upstreamOutputsHint: Each glob is that step intent's stop-hook output contract — needs-ordering and stop-hook enforcement guarantee it exists before this step runs; it expands to the actual files at fire time.
step.retryIdempotency: A retried run may repeat side effects — this intent must check what already completed before acting.
step.needsHint: This step runs after every selected step finished. Pick several for a fan-in; several steps depending on one make a fan-out. No selection makes it a root.
step.gateNeedsUpstream: An approval gate needs an upstream step — pick at least one.

runs.empty: No runs yet — press Run now to test this pipeline.
runs.emptyOther: No runs recorded for this activation yet.
